WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND ( UPPER(WAREHOUSE_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(WAREHOUSE_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
mapper.select:
SELECT WAREHOUSE_ID, WAREHOUSE_CODE, WAREHOUSE_NAME, WAREHOUSE_TYPE, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, ordered_warehouse.* FROM ( SELECT WAREHOUSE_ID, WAREHOUSE_CODE, WAREHOUSE_NAME, WAREHOUSE_TYPE, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM WAREHOUSE
ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_CODE ASC ) ordered_warehouse WHERE ROWNUM <= #{pageNum} * #{amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{pageNum} - 1) * #{amount} ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_CODE ASC
